prompt: Beatriz's dog wouldn't have eaten the cake if she (to close) the window.
explanation_ru: Речь о прошлом, которое уже не изменить: в придаточном с if используется Past Perfect (had closed).

prompt: If Bruno had heard the bell, he (not / to miss) his new phone.
explanation_ru: Воображаемый результат в прошлом передаётся через would not have + V3 (would not have missed).

prompt: My train to Turin was delayed; I (to reach) my cousin's graduation if it (to arrive) on time.
explanation_ru: Поезд уже опоздал и выпускной прошёл, поэтому нужен третий тип: would have + V3 в главной части и Past Perfect после if.

prompt: Greta mixed up two jars; she (not / to ruin) the cake if she (to taste) the powder first.
explanation_ru: Пирог уже испорчен, поэтому для нереального прошлого используем would not have ruined в результате и had tasted в условии.

prompt: Leila was the fastest runner at school; (she / to win) that race if she (not / to leave) the team?
explanation_ru: В вопросе третьего типа модальный глагол выносится перед подлежащим (would she have won), а в отрицательном условии стоит had not left.

prompt: After dropping his phone in a puddle, Georgi realised he (to keep) all his photos if he (to use) online storage.
explanation_ru: Фотографии уже потеряны, поэтому обе части относятся к нереальному прошлому: would have kept и had used.

prompt: "Why was Henrik last on his bike?" "He (to be) here earlier if he (not / to take) the long road."
explanation_ru: Поездка уже закончилась: для альтернативного исхода в прошлом нужны would have been и had not taken.

prompt: Nobody warned Yan that the storm was moving faster than forecast, though he (to escape) the rough sea if he (to sail) an hour earlier as planned.
explanation_ru: Шторм уже застал лодку в море, поэтому гипотетическое спасение в прошлом строится через would/could/might have escaped и Past Perfect (had sailed).

prompt: I ignored the signs about the road closure in Amman and sat in heavy traffic, even though I (to avoid) the whole jam if I (to check) the local news first.
explanation_ru: Пробка уже случилась в прошлом, поэтому для упущенной возможности используем would/could have avoided и had checked.

prompt: When my manager cancelled my holiday in Antalya, I lost the whole deposit; if I (to read) the booking rules carefully, I (not / to choose) a room with no refund.
explanation_ru: Бронирование и потеря денег уже произошли, поэтому в условии стоит Past Perfect (had read), а в результате — would not have chosen.

prompt: Last Saturday was the busiest afternoon at Regula's noodle shop in Penang. She tried a brand-new recipe instead of making extra pots of her popular soup, and hungry regulars left early. "If I (to cook) our usual soup, we (not / to run) out before two o'clock," she sighed. "Everyone (to go) home happy."
explanation_ru: Вся история относится к прошлой субботе: в условии с if используется had cooked, а оба воображаемых результата строятся через would (not) have + V3.

prompt: "Kenji looks exhausted after running back to our flat between lectures." "I'm not surprised, because he left his printed essay on the kitchen table. If I (to see) the folder before leaving, I (to bring) it to campus for him. Still, (he / to remember) it if he hadn't stayed up all night?"
explanation_ru: События утра уже позади: в условии стоит had seen, в утвердительном результате — would have brought, а в вопросе — обратный порядок слов (would he have remembered).

prompt: "I'm really sorry, sir, I left my history project on my desk at home." "Don't worry, Thandi, you can present it tomorrow instead. You (not / to forget) it if you (to pack) your bag the night before." "True—if I hadn't rushed out so fast, I (to put) it straight inside."
explanation_ru: Танди уже забыла проект дома, поэтому обсуждение упущенного утра идёт в третьем типе: would not have forgotten, had packed и would have put.

prompt: Everything went wrong at the car workshop in Munich on the morning of the safety inspection. Stefan's phone had run out of battery overnight, so his alarm never rang and he walked in an hour after the inspectors arrived. If he (to charge) it before going to sleep, he (to greet) them calmly with all the paperwork ready. Instead, he spent the afternoon laughing at how differently the morning (to turn) out.
explanation_ru: Проверка уже прошла, поэтому все три пропуска описывают нереальное прошлое: had charged в условии и would/could/might have + V3 в воображаемых результатах.

prompt: Dimitris agreed to cover a night shift at the hospital in Nakuru to help a tired colleague. Exhausted after twelve hours on duty, he missed the final hour to sign up for a senior training course. Looking back, he (to apply) for the better post if he (not / to change) his schedule. Even his manager admitted that the board (to support) his application if it had arrived in time.
explanation_ru: Запись на курс уже закрылась в прошлом, поэтому нужны формы третьего типа: would have applied и would/might/could have supported в результатах и had not changed в условии.

prompt: I stayed in central Izmir on Friday to finish some errands instead of catching the coach to my parents' house. It turned out my uncle drove up unexpectedly with fresh figs and everyone stayed at the table until midnight. If I (to know) he was coming, I (not / to stay) in the city a minute longer. Even if the coach had been full, I (to borrow) my flatmate's car to make it for dinner.
explanation_ru: Семейный ужин уже прошёл: после if ставится Past Perfect (had known), а в главных частях — would (not) have + V3.

prompt: If Boris ___ earlier, he would have seen the doctor for free.
options: would have woken up
had woken up
had woke up
woke up
explanation_ru: После if в третьем типе нужен Past Perfect (had woken up). Частые ошибки — ставить would после if или вторую форму глагола (had woke) вместо третьей.

prompt: Arjun ___ his grandfather's guitar if he had found another way.
options: wouldn't sell
didn't sell
wouldn't have sold
wouldn't had sold
explanation_ru: В главной части третьего типа используется wouldn't have + V3 (wouldn't have sold). Вариант wouldn't had — типичная ошибка с неверным вспомогательным глаголом.

prompt: Willem told reporters that the monkeys wouldn't have broken the visitor's phone if he ___ over the fence.
options: wouldn't have leaned
didn't lean
hasn't leaned
hadn't leaned
explanation_ru: Условие относится к завершённому прошлому, поэтому после if требуется Past Perfect (hadn't leaned), а не wouldn't have или Past Simple.

prompt: If Lucia had switched to a factory mix before the festival, her bread ___ the village prize.
options: might not have won
might not had won
didn't win
won't have won
explanation_ru: Для вероятного нереального результата в прошлом подходит might not have + V3. После модального глагола всегда идёт have, а не had.

prompt: If Esra had took another job, she would not have worked there.
answer: If Esra had taken another job, she would not have worked there.
accepted_answers: If Esra had taken another job, she would not have worked there.
If Esra had taken another job, she wouldn't have worked there.
explanation_ru: В Past Perfect после had нужна третья форма глагола (taken), а не вторая (took).

prompt: Carolina would never have worked at the Lima court if she would have studied art instead of law.
answer: Carolina would never have worked at the Lima court if she had studied art instead of law.
accepted_answers: Carolina would never have worked at the Lima court if she had studied art instead of law.
Carolina would never have worked at the Lima court if she'd studied art instead of law.
explanation_ru: После if нельзя ставить would have (калька с русского «если бы»): в условии о прошлом нужен Past Perfect (had studied).

prompt: If Kamal had closed his shop early last year, he'd never have taught those children to play the guitar.
answer: If Kamal had closed his shop early last year, he'd never have taught those children to play the guitar.
accepted_answers: If Kamal had closed his shop early last year, he'd never have taught those children to play the guitar.
If Kamal had closed his shop early last year, he would never have taught those children to play the guitar.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: в условии стоит Past Perfect (had closed), а he'd в главной части — это естественное сокращение от he would.

prompt: Twenty years ago, Daan turned down a ship captain's post, and his wife says he would missed his children growing up if he had gone to sea.
answer: Twenty years ago, Daan turned down a ship captain's post, and his wife says he would have missed his children growing up if he had gone to sea.
accepted_answers: Twenty years ago, Daan turned down a ship captain's post, and his wife says he would have missed his children growing up if he had gone to sea.
Twenty years ago, Daan turned down a ship captain's post, and his wife says he'd have missed his children growing up if he had gone to sea.
explanation_ru: В главной части третьего типа пропущен глагол have: правильно would have missed, а не would missed.

prompt: Sumi took a tiny role in a school film in Busan as a joke. Because of that afternoon, she decided to apply to film college.
options: If Sumi hadn't taken that small role, she might never have applied to film college.
If Sumi had taken that small role, she would have applied to film college.
If Sumi didn't take that small role, she wouldn't apply to film college.
If Sumi hadn't taken that small role, she will never apply to film college.
explanation_ru: Суми на самом деле сыграла роль и подала документы в прошлом, поэтому нереальное условие меняет знак на противоположный и использует третий тип.

prompt: I turned down a job at a famous modern art museum in Doha because I wanted to stay near my family, so I never got to travel for exhibitions.
options: If I would have accepted the museum post in Doha, I could have travelled for exhibitions.
If I hadn't accepted the museum post in Doha, I wouldn't have travelled for exhibitions.
If I had accepted the museum post in Doha, I could have travelled for exhibitions.
If I accepted the museum post in Doha, I would have travelled for exhibitions.
explanation_ru: Говорящий отказался от работы в прошлом, поэтому нужно утвердительное условие в Past Perfect (had accepted) и результат с could have + V3.

prompt: Hasan bought his corner shop in Leeds, so he didn't pay high mall rent last year. → If Hasan hadn't bought …

accepted_answers: If Hasan hadn't bought his corner shop in Leeds, he would have paid high mall rent last year.

If Hasan hadn't bought his corner shop in Leeds, he'd have paid high mall rent last year.
If Hasan had not bought his corner shop in Leeds, he'd have paid high mall rent last year.

accepted_answers: We would have lost touch after university if Jakub hadn't started our monthly dinner club in Prague.

We'd have lost touch after university if Jakub had not started our monthly dinner club in Prague.

answer: If Lukas had taken a solo singing job in Vienna, he wouldn't have had time to build the school choir.
accepted_answers: If Lukas had taken a solo singing job in Vienna, he wouldn't have had time to build the school choir.
If Lukas had taken a solo singing job in Vienna, he would not have had time to build the school choir.
If Lukas had taken the solo singing job in Vienna, he wouldn't have had time to build the school choir.

prompt: If Dara hadn't worked at the hotel, she wouldn't have met her husband.
options: Dara didn't work at the hotel, and she met her husband.
Dara worked at the hotel, and she met her husband.
Dara worked at the hotel, and she didn't meet her husband.
Dara works at the hotel, so she may meet her husband.

prompt: If Nikos had sold the olive grove in Crete, he would have lost his family's bees.
options: Nikos sold the olive grove, and he lost his family's bees.

prompt: Imani wouldn't have opened her photo studio in Nairobi if she'd ignored her uncle's lessons as a teenager.
options: Imani opened her photo studio because she paid attention to her uncle's lessons.

prompt: I'd never have saved my balcony tomatoes last summer if I hadn't studied plant science in Kyoto.
options: I studied plant science in Kyoto, but my balcony tomatoes still died last summer.

I studied plant science in Kyoto, and I saved my balcony tomatoes last summer.

prompt: Tariq might never have finished the Casablanca half-marathon if a doctor hadn't warned him to change his habits after a mild health scare.
options: A doctor didn't warn Tariq, so he never finished the Casablanca half-marathon.
A doctor warned Tariq after a mild health scare, and he went on to finish the Casablanca half-marathon.
A doctor warned Tariq after a mild health scare, yet he still failed to finish the half-marathon.
A doctor is warning Tariq to change his habits before the next Casablanca half-marathon.

prompt: Match each half to complete Pavel's story at Prague airport.
pairs: If Pavel's flight had landed on time,
his friend would have waited at arrivals.
If Pavel hadn't brought such heavy luggage,
he could have carried it easily onto the tram.
if his phone had run out of battery?
The driver wouldn't have left without him
if the delay had been shorter.
explanation_ru: В каждой паре одна часть выражает нереальное условие в Past Perfect, а другая — результат в прошлом с would/could have + V3.

prompt: Find the two mistakes in Kasia's message about saving money in Krakow.
sentences: Moving back to my parents' house in Krakow last year was tough because I had to share a room with my younger sister.
Still, if I would have rented a flat of my own, I would have spent half my wages on bills.
My sister joked that we wouldn't have argued over shelf space if we'd had a bigger wardrobe.
If I hadn't stayed with my family during those months, I could never have saved enough for a deposit.
Honestly, if I had knew how fast the year would pass, I wouldn't have complained so much at first.

fixes.1: Still, if I had rented a flat of my own, I would have spent half my wages on bills.
fixes.4: Honestly, if I had known how fast the year would pass, I wouldn't have complained so much at first.

explanation_ru: В предложении 2 после if ошибочно стоит would have (нужно had rented), а в предложении 5 после had использована вторая форма knew вместо третьей known.

prompt: Put the words in order to ask about Huong's noodle shop in Da Nang.
answer: What would Huong have done if the noodle shop had failed?
accepted_answers: What would Huong have done if the noodle shop had failed?
